messages.content: What are the boiling and melting points of water and iron at sea levels of 0 meters and 1000 meters respectively?

function.name: get_boiling_melting_points

The boiling point of iron at standard pressure is 2862°C. But at lower pressure, boiling point decreases. We need to estimate using Clausius-Clapeyron. But maybe we can approximate.
